name: study-notebook-online
description: The online copy of your Study Notebook: lets Claude use your notebook in any chat (web, phone, desktop), and syncs with the Study Notebook app on your laptop.

NOTEBOOK_PASSWORD.description: Choose a password for your online notebook (at least 10 characters). You type it once when you add the connector in Claude, and once in the Study Notebook app on your laptop.

DB.description: Where your notes are stored online.

OAUTH_KV.description: Stores Claude's sign-in to your notebook.
